definition: a permanent mark on the skin from a healed wound
description: Three animated friends sit around crates of mugs on a beach pier at sunset comparing scars: a red-haired woman rolls up her sleeve to show a forearm scar from a hot pan, a bearded man shows a bigger one on his arm, and a third friend tops them both with a huge scar along his shin.
transcript: Hot pan, two years ago. Hah, mine is bigger. Boys, look at this. [gasping] [laughing]
